    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ArmoredEnemy
    A heavily armoured enemy — high HP, slow movement, and physical resistance.
    ArrowTower
    A fast, low-damage tower that fires arrows at the closest enemy in range.
    Base
    Abstract base class representing the player's base that must be defended.
    BasicEnemy
    A standard ground enemy — the most common unit in most waves.
    CannonProjectile
    Abstract projectile fired by the CannonTower.
    CannonTower
    A slow, high-damage tower that fires cannonballs at the highest-HP enemy in range.
    ConfigManager
    Loads and provides access to game configuration from a .properties file.
    Enemy
    Abstract base class for all enemy types.
    EnemyType
    The enemy types, as a polymorphic dispatcher over the Abstract Factory.
    Entity
    Abstract base class for every object in the game world.
    EntityFactory
    Abstract Factory interface for creating all game entities.
    FloatingTextKind
    Semantic category of a floating text.
    FloatingTextWorld
    Data-oriented / ECS datastore for short-lived floating combat text.
    FlyingEnemy
    A fast flying enemy — ignores ground terrain and follows its own aerial path.
    Game
    Central singleton representing the entire Tower Defence game.
    GameMap
    Represents a single level's map: the tile grid, enemy paths, build spots, spawn point and base position.
    GameState
    Represents the possible states of the Tower Defence game.
    GameView
    Abstraction for the visualization layer, used by Game to render and read input without depending on any specific graphics library (Java2D, OpenGL, etc.).
    IceTower
    A support tower that slows all enemies within its range.
    InputHandler
    Handles all keyboard and mouse input for the Java2D visualization.
    J2dArmoredEnemy
    Concrete ArmoredEnemy with Java2D rendering.
    J2dArrowTower
    Concrete ArrowTower with Java2D rendering.
    J2dBase
    Concrete Base with Java2D rendering.
    J2dBasicEnemy
    Concrete BasicEnemy with Java2D rendering.
    J2dCannonProjectile
    Concrete CannonProjectile with Java2D rendering.
    J2dCannonTower
    Concrete CannonTower with Java2D rendering.
    J2dEntityFactory
    Concrete factory — the Java2D implementation of EntityFactory.
    J2dFlyingEnemy
    Concrete FlyingEnemy with Java2D rendering.
    J2dGame
    The Java2D visualization layer — manages the game window, coordinate conversion, and the rendering pipeline.
    J2dIceTower
    Concrete IceTower with Java2D rendering.
    J2dRayProjectile
    Concrete RayProjectile with Java2D rendering — used for the raygun (ArrowTower) single-target shots.
    LifetimeSystem
    ECS system — ages every floating text and removes the expired ones.
    LuaScriptEngine
    Wikkelt de LuaJ runtime voor enemy AI-scripts.
    Main
    Application entry point.
    MovementSystem
    ECS system — moves every floating text upward each frame.
    Path
    An ordered sequence of waypoints that enemies follow from spawn to base.
    Position
    Represents a 2D position in the game world using double-precision coordinates.
    Projectile
    Abstract base class for all projectiles fired by towers.
    RayProjectile
    Abstract single-target projectile fired by the ArrowTower (raygun).
    SpriteManager
    Loads and caches sprite images from the resources/images/ directory.
    Stopwatch
    Measures elapsed time between game loop ticks for frame-independent movement.
    Tile
    Represents a single cell in the GameMap grid.
    TileType
    Defines the different terrain types a tile can have on the game map.
    Tower
    Abstract base class for all tower types.
    TowerType
    The playable tower types, as a polymorphic dispatcher over the Abstract Factory.
    Wave
    Stelt één golf van vijanden voor.
    Wave.EnemyEntry
    Beschrijft één groep vijanden binnen een golf: een type ("basic", "armored" of "flying") en het aantal te spawnen exemplaren.
    WaveManager
    Beheert de volgorde en timing van alle golven in een level.
